symbol_selection: First completely retained ticker in the official FNSPID CSV prefix; selected before any price query or outcome/model inspection
reason_dates: 2016+ historical market-data coverage and first complete ticker headline coverage; not chosen by returns
return_basis: split-adjusted opening price change, cash dividends excluded; not total return
target: stock opening price return minus SPY opening price return
strategy: Non-overlapping 10-session long/cash company positions from predicted relative-return sign; no shorting, no orders, no annualization
limitations: Historical exact text versions and availability are not independently verified
Dataset symbol tags are not independent company relevance annotations
Proxy event groups cannot certify all real-world event identities
A single-company historical development slice is not a final holdout or alpha evidence

asset_mapping.verification: Issuer-indexed primary content checked; direct issuer snapshot returned HTTP 403; no historical asset-master completeness claim
